title: Drawing near to betray is not drawing near to Jesus
english: [[See, the one who betrays me has drawn near >> Bible:Matthew 26:46]]. It is not the same to draw near to Jesus and to draw near in order to hand him over. The traitor had already lengthened the distance by his sins and by the plot to betray; he drew near to deliver the Son of God whom he had already sold. All transgressors first betray Jesus, then hand him over.
translator_notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Judas and the armed crowd
english: While he was still speaking, [[Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs >> Bible:Matthew 26:47]], sent from the chief priests. Some say they feared the multitude of believers would snatch him away; I think they supposed he could escape by magical arts — having heard how he had once slipped those who would throw him down. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Series rem arrest from PG 13 Latin.
